description.plain:
HDZero Gamma 45A HD-Ready AIO

25.5×25.5mm for 2.5–4in Digital FPV Builds (3-6s)

The HDZero Gamma 45A HD-Ready AIO is a compact, digital-first all-in-one flight controller designed for 2.5–4 inch FPV drones using the popular 25.5×25.5mm Whoop / Toothpick mounting pattern.

Built around the STM32G473 MCU, Gamma delivers strong processing headroom for modern Betaflight features while keeping builds clean, simple, and reliable.

Integrated ExpressLRS Receiver

Gamma includes a built-in serial ExpressLRS 2.4GHz receiver, eliminating the need for a separate RX. This reduces wiring, saves space, and removes one of the most frustrating steps in small digital builds.

Designed for Digital Video

Gamma is purpose-built for digital FPV systems. A standard digital VTX plug and a protected 8V / 3A high-power BEC make it easy to run modern digital transmitters, including HDZero, DJI, Walksnail, and OpenIPC. A secondary 5V / 3A BEC is available for LEDs and peripherals.

The analog OSD chip is intentionally removed to save space and optimize the board for digital-only setups, making Gamma an excellent match for compact digital stacks using VTX's like the HDZero Whoop V2 or HDZero Freestyle V2.

High-Performance 32-bit AM32 ESC

The onboard 32-bit 4-in-1 AM32 ESC provides clean, stable power delivery and improved transient response during rapid throttle changes. Each motor output supports 45A continuous with 60A burst capability, helping reduce voltage spikes, brownouts, and component stress. Supports 3-6s batteries for high performance flying.

Builder-Friendly Layout

All motor and I/O pads are castellated and edge-mounted, making soldering easier and improving serviceability in tight frames - you can even mount the AIO upside down and still access all of the IO pads. The layout is optimized for clean wiring and straightforward integration of additional peripherals such as GPS, LEDs, or buzzers.

Key Features

  • 25.5×25.5mm Whoop / Toothpick mounting pattern
  • Optimized for 2.5–4 inch digital FPV builds
  • STM32G473 MCU with ICM gyro
  • Integrated serial ExpressLRS 2.4GHz receiver
  • 45A continuous / 60A burst 32-bit AM32 4-in-1 ESC
  • 8V / 3A protected BEC for digital VTXs
  • 5V / 3A BEC for LEDs and peripherals
  • Standard digital VTX plug
  • Castellated edge pads for clean, easy soldering

At-a-Glance Specs

Mounting 25.5×25.5mm (Whoop / Toothpick), 8.4g
Recommended Builds 2.5–4 inch digital FPV
MCU STM32G473
Receiver Integrated serial ExpressLRS 2.4GHz
ESC Firmware AM32 (32-bit 4-in-1)
Motor Output 45A continuous / 60A burst (per output), 3-6s
Digital VTX Power Protected 8V / 3A BEC
Peripheral Power 5V / 3A BEC
Video Integration Standard digital VTX plug
OSD Analog OSD chip removed (digital-optimized)


Included in the Box

  • HDZero Gamma 45A HD-Ready AIO
  • 1x ELRS T-sharp short antenna (40mm)
  • 5x M2 Rubber Grommet(5.6mm)
  • 1x XT30 cable with 330uF/35V capacitor (70mm)

Recommended Use

Ideal for 2.5–4 inch digital FPV drones, including freestyle, racing, training, and drone soccer platforms. Not recommended for heavy 5-inch builds.

Notes
  • Designed for digital video systems using a standard digital VTX plug and an 8V / 3A regulated rail.
  • 5V rail is intended for peripherals (LEDs, etc.). Use appropriate protection if your wiring could be shorted.

description.plain:
With the rise of digital transmission, FLYWOO presents an innovative solution for 1-2S HD Micro Drones. The GOKU F405 HD V2 AIO integrates a Type-C interface, a high-performance F405 BGA MCU, and multiple UARTs. It features a built-in 9V 2A BEC module to prevent power cuts in the O3 Air unit. It also includes a serial ELRS 2.4G receiver, an 8MB black box, a barometer, and a current sensor for HD VTX. The socket-style motor connections and plug-and-play O3 design simplify installation and debugging, ensuring efficiency and convenience.

July 2026: Gyro changed to BMI270.

Check out all our Whoop/AIO Flight Controllers and our other great products from Flywoo!

Features

  • Multifunctional Design
  • Plug-and-Play O3 Port
  • Motor Socket Design
  • New Power Supply
  • Type-C Design

SERIAL ELRS 2.4GHz RX

1. Receiver protocol Serial ELRS 2.4G RX uses the Crossfire serial (CRSF) protocol to communicate between the receiver and the flight controller board. So, the Serial ELRS 2.4G RX supports upgrading to ELRS Configurator with no need to flash Betaflight flight controller firmware.

2. Binding steps     

  • To enter the binding mode, unplug and plug the power/data cable three times;
  • The RX LED will flash rapidly twice, indicating the receiver is in binding mode;
  • Ensure the TX module or wireless transmitter enters binding mode;
  • If the receiver's light stays on constantly, it's bound.

3. Upgrade steps

  • The Serial ELRS 2.4G RX can be updated via Wi-Fi or Betaflight serial passthrough. 
  • Insert the FC into the computer, but do not connect to the Betaflight configurator.
  • Select the target "FLYWOO 2.4Ghz EL24P"
  • Use the BetaflightPassthrough option in the ExpressLRS configurator for the upgrade.

9V ELECTRONIC SWITCH

By controlling the switch of USER2, it is possible to control all 9V power supplies to the flight controller, temporarily shutting off the image transmission to avoid damage to the equipment due to prolonged high temperatures. Connect the flight controller to the BF configurator and switch to the Modes interface. Scroll down to find USER2, select "Add Range," then move the joystick switch on the remote controller you wish to configure. Afterward, save the motor settings. Activate USER2.

ESC FIRMWARE

The ESC firmware defaults to Bluejay 0.19.2 48KHz.
Supports bidirectional D-shot and RPM filtering in Betaflight
It doesn’t recommend upgrading the 96KHz, or it might cause an error in the motor idle setting, not spinning when disarmed.
DO NOT flash the firmware at a shorter interval; otherwise, there will be a certain chance of stalling and burning the flight controller.

Specifications

ONBOARD 4-in-1 ESC

  • Support: Oneshot125, Oneshot42, Multishot, Dshot150, Dshot300, Dshot600
  • Built-in: 1S/2S 12A BL_S 4-in-1 ESC
  • Firmware: Z_H_30_REV16.7
  • Input Voltage: 1-2S Lipo
  • Firmware: BLHELI_S

FLIGHT CONTROLLER

  • BF Flight Controller Firmware: FLYWOOF405S_AIO
  • Mounting Pattern: 25.5x25.5-3mm
  • INAV Firmware: FLYWOOF405HD
  • Barometer: DPS310 / SPL06
  • Motor: M1-M4 OUTPUT
  • MCU: STM32F405BGA
  • UARTs: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
  • BEC: 5V 2A / 9V 2A
  • Connector: Type-C
  • Gyro: BMI270
  • LED: 2WS2812
  • Size: 30x30mm
  • I2C: SCL/SDA
  • Weight: 4.9g
  • Flash: 8M
  • OSD: NO

ELRS 2.4G RX

  • Frequency Range: 2400 MHz to 2500 MHz
  • Maximum Receive Refresh Rate: 500Hz
  • Minimum Receiver Refresh Rate: 25Hz
  • Firmware: Flywoo EL24P 2400 RX
  • RF Module: SX1280IMLTRT 
  • MCU: ESP8285 
  • Serial: UART 1
  • Version: 3.X.X

ESC Configurator

Includes

  • 1x Flywoo GOKU F405 V2 1-2S AIO Whoop/Toothpick Flight Controller (w/ 12A BLHeli_S 4in1 ESC) + ELRS 2.4 GHz 
  • 1x DJI O3 Connection Cable
  • 1x PH 2.0 Battery Lead
  • 4x JST Straight Socket
  • 1x XT30 Power Cable
  • 1x Hardware Set
  • 1x Capacitor

Description

  • iFlight BLITZ F411 1S 5A Whoop AIO Build-in ELRS 2.4GHz W/SMA Antenna 25.5x25.5
  • Integrates 2.4G CC2500 receiver for seamless connectivity
  • Supports BLHeliSuite for customizable flight settings
  • Weighs only 4.8g, ideal for lightweight drone builds
  • Features BMI270 gyro for precise stabilization
  • Offers VTX with 48 channels and Smart Audio protocol

The iFlight BLITZ F411 1S 5A Whoop AIO Build-in ELRS 2.4GHz W/SMA Antenna 25.5x25.5 is a sophisticated all-in-one flight controller designed for drone enthusiasts seeking lightweight and efficient performance. Weighing only 4.8 grams, this compact unit integrates a 2.4G CC2500 receiver, making it an ideal choice for streamlined drone builds.

Equipped with an STM32F411 microcontroller, the flight controller supports BLHeliSuite programming, allowing for customizable flight configurations. The unit operates on a 1S power supply and features a BMI270 gyro for precise flight stabilization. The mounting pattern measures 25.5x25.5mm, ensuring compatibility with a variety of drone frames.

The electronic speed controller (ESC) supports multiple signal protocols, including Dshot, Oneshot, and Multishot, with a continuous current capacity of 5A and a peak of 6A. The ESC firmware options include O-H-30 BLS 16.8 (BlheliS) and Bluejay Q-H-50 (Bluejay), providing flexibility in performance tuning.

The video transmitter (VTX) operates on the Smart Audio protocol, offering power options of PIT, 25mW, and 50mW across 48 channels. The VTX is equipped with a UFL/IPEX connector and requires a 5V input voltage.

Note: F.PORT protocol RX input is supported, but telemetry is not supported.
